name: Doppler CLI
description: Protects against destructive Doppler CLI operations like deleting secrets, \ configs, environments, or projects.

destructive_patterns.name: doppler-secrets-delete
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a secret removes configuration data that applications depend on. \ Services using 'doppler run' or synced secrets will fail when the secret \ is not found. Deleted secrets cannot be recovered.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - doppler secrets get: Export secret value first \ - doppler secrets set: Update value instead of deleting \ - Verify which environments/configs reference the secret

destructive_patterns.name: doppler-projects-delete
destructive_patterns.description: doppler projects delete removes a project.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a Doppler project removes all environments, configs, and secrets \ within it. All applications referencing this project will lose access to \ their secrets. This action cannot be undone.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - doppler secrets download: Export all secrets first \ - Review active integrations and service tokens \ - Archive the project configuration for recovery

destructive_patterns.name: doppler-environments-delete
destructive_patterns.description: doppler environments delete removes an environment.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a Doppler environment removes all configs within that environment. \ Applications targeting this environment (dev, staging, prod) will fail to \ retrieve secrets. Inherited configurations are also lost.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - doppler secrets download: Export environment secrets \ - doppler configs list: Review all configs in environment \ - Ensure no active deployments use this environment

destructive_patterns.name: doppler-configs-delete
destructive_patterns.description: doppler configs delete removes a config.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a Doppler config removes all secret values specific to that config. \ Branch configs and inheriting configs may also be affected. Applications \ using this config will fail to start or authenticate.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - doppler secrets download --config=X: Export config secrets \ - doppler configs list: Understand config hierarchy \ - Migrate secrets to a new config before deletion
